description: The file is the entry point for a web application, handling initial requests, configuration, and routing logic. It loads dependencies, sets up environment settings, and directs the request to the appropriate response or redirect.

classes.name: Framework
classes.description: Main application kernel responsible for handling HTTP requests and responses.

classes.name: Request
classes.description: Represents an HTTP request, with methods to create an instance from global PHP variables and to access request data.

classes.name: RedirectResponse
classes.description: Handles HTTP redirects by sending appropriate headers to the client.

methods.name: createFromGlobals
methods.description: Creates a Request object based on PHP's global variables.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor for Framework and RedirectResponse classes, initializing object state.

methods.name: handleRequest
methods.description: Processes the incoming request and returns an appropriate response.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Outputs the response to the client.

methods.name: terminate
methods.description: Performs any cleanup or final actions after the response has been sent.

methods.name: getBaseUrl
methods.description: Retrieves the base URL of the current request.
